name: Tongue Tie
description:
Concentration, up to 8 hours.

Roll Spirit vs Spirit against a creature within medium range. On a win, choose a topic of conversation. Whenever the creature attempts to speak about the chosen topic, you, or this spell, a phenomenon or your choice spills forth from its lips instead of words:

  • Tiny toads, snakes, moths or other vermin

  • Short-lived wildflowers in full bloom

  • Black filth or bile

  • Fairy tales and nursery rhymes

  • Unflattering, unrelated truths about itself or those they are addressing

Telepathic communication circumvents this spell, but writing about the subject results in crude drawings of the chosen phenomenon.

If you have caught the creature in a lie, or if it was rude or ungrateful after you granted a request from it, the creature's Spirit roll is ill-favored, the spell doesn’t require concentration, and the effect is permanent unless removed by magic. You can also choose to end the spell by using an action to dismiss it.
